## GoPro Quik App Editing Guide

This document outlines the key concepts for editing videos using the GoPro Quik mobile app.

### Getting Started

- The app's primary editing features are available through a paid subscription.
- The workflow begins by connecting to your GoPro, downloading footage to the app, and creating a new project, called a **"Mural"**.

> [!NOTE]
> The GoPro Quik subscription costs $49.99/year or $4.99/month and includes a one-month free trial. It provides access to advanced editing features and a library of licensed music.

### Core Editing Tools

Once clips are in your project timeline, you can edit them individually:

- **Trimming**: Use the trim function to adjust the **start** and **end** points of each clip.
- **Speed Ramps**: Select a clip, go to the **Speed** tool, and add points (`+`) on the clip's timeline. You can then adjust the playback speed between these points to create **slow-motion** (e.g., 1/2x) or **fast-motion** (e.g., 8x) effects.
- **Framing**: The **Frame** tool allows you to **rotate**, **flip** (horizontally/vertically), or change the angle of your shot.
- **Filters & Color**: Apply pre-made color styles (**Filters**) and adjust their intensity with a slider. For more control, use the **Color** tool to adjust:
  - Exposure
  - Contrast
  - Vibrance
  - Temperature
  - Shadows & Highlights

### Polishing Your Video

These adjustments affect the entire video project:

- **Themes**: Apply global styles like **Glitch** or **Travel** which add coordinated transitions and effects throughout your video.
- **Music**: Swap the default track with songs from the **GoPro Originals** library. All tracks are licensed for online use without copyright issues.
- **Duration**: Use the **stopwatch icon** to change the total length of your video. The app will automatically adjust clip speeds to fit the new duration.
- **Aspect Ratio**: Easily format your video for different platforms.

> [!TIP]
> Use the aspect ratio tool to quickly switch between **16:9** (standard widescreen), **1:1** (square for Instagram posts), and **9:16** (vertical for Stories/Reels).

### Exporting & Sharing

- Once your edit is complete, **save** the project.
- From the main screen, select your finished video and use the **Upload** button.
- You can **save the video to your phone's photos** or **share it directly** to platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
